blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm masle hal karne ka seedha aur aasani se samajh aane wala (intuitive) tareeqa hai jo artificial intelligence aur computer science mein aam istemal hota hai. Yeh algorithm pehle masle ke mumkina hal (potential solutions) banata (generate karta) hai, phir har hal ko test karta hai ke woh zaroori sharait (conditions) poori karta hai ya nahi. Yeh amal tab tak chalta hai jab tak tasalli bakhsh hal na mil jaye ya tamam mumkina hal aazmaye na ja chuke hon.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test kab rukta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab koi hal test paas kar le (sharait poori kare), ya jab tamam mumkina hal aazmaye ja chuke hon.

items: Generate and Test: hal banao, test karo, dohrao, jab tak koi hal chal jaye ya koi hal baqi na rahe.
